packageRules.description: Dev tooling can land on its own once CI is green. Runtime dependencies and every major open a PR for review instead.
Pinned to a prerelease the generated ANTLR sources are built against; moving it means regenerating the parsers.

TypeScript 7 is a hard blocker, not a preference: typescript-eslint refuses it, and the CLI parses SQL-in-TS through the compiler API that TS 7's native rewrite does not expose. Take 6.x updates, hold at the major.
The docs site is not part of the library build.
